breaking_news.headline: A negative Outlook: Microsoft scrambles to fix email outage
breaking_news.summary: Early Friday, after Outlook had been down for more than 12 hours, Microsoft reported "marginal success."

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX's giant rocket may leave NASA in the dust
breaking_news.summary: As it races to develop its new massive rocket, the space launch company is preparing to retire NASA's main ride to the International Space Station.

breaking_news.headline: Does Europe regret its bet on U.S. defense?
breaking_news.summary: Europe bet big on American defense technology and they're now paying the price. Years-long backlogs are underway due to production delays and the U.S. own military needs.

breaking_news.headline: Is there an opening for Nvidia's competitors, now that Jensen Huang is out?
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dylan Patel of the AI and semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis about Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, and whether it opens up the field for Nvidia's competitors.

breaking_news.headline: These economists say in-person work boosts creativity, but office mandates fall short
breaking_news.summary: A pair economists argue in a new book that people are more creative and productive when they work together in person. But it's not enough for employers to simply order workers back to the office.

breaking_news.headline: Commerce Department under pressure for delaying export controls on Nvidia chips
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department is under scrutiny for clearing Chinese companies to handle Nvidia chips, despite national security concerns from cabinet officials and U.S. intelligence agencies.

breaking_news.headline: New rule aims to close loophole on chip exports
breaking_news.summary: The Commerce Department released a new rule designed to make it harder for China to gain access to America's most powerful computer chips using third-country data centers.

breaking_news.headline: She went to college to become a social worker. Now she's joined the skilled trades
breaking_news.summary: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in people of all backgrounds including college graduates.

breaking_news.headline: Mozambique opposition leader faces trial over deadly 2024 election unrest
breaking_news.summary: Venâncio Mondlane faces several charges over 2024 post-election protests that left hundreds of people dead.

breaking_news.headline: Japan sends up jets after alleged Russian incursion of its airspace
breaking_news.summary: Taiwan and South Korea also responded to Russian military aircraft detected near their airspaces.

breaking_news.headline: Body of Melbourne Cup horse found dumped in Sydney skip
breaking_news.summary: The remains of a top Australian racehorse that died of colic on Monday were found at a public rubbish tip.

breaking_news.headline: Imran Khan seeks urgent medical care fearing he 'may not return alive'
breaking_news.summary: Pakistan's ex-prime minister, who has been in prison since August 2023, says he has been denied justice.

breaking_news.headline: Indian woman gang-raped while pregnant in 2002 'heartbroken' after two perpetrators bailed
breaking_news.summary: Bilkis Bano has spoken of her "pain, shock and disbelief" at the top court order and vowed to fight back.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine accuses Russia of targeting rescue operation after 'double-tap' strike kills 72
breaking_news.summary: Efforts to recover bodies after a “double-tap” attack in southern Ukraine are being hampered by continuing Russian strikes, officials say.

breaking_news.headline: Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine says the attack took weeks to plan, while the Kremlin vows to rebuild the strategic bridge.

breaking_news.headline: Gas starts flowing from Jackdaw after government green light
breaking_news.summary: Ministers last month announced the Jackdaw gas field, which lies 150 miles east of Aberdeen, had been approved after years of uncertainty.

breaking_news.headline: Faisal Islam: What's in the Brexit reset food deal and are there trade-offs?
breaking_news.summary: EU minister Hamish Falconer insists Britain would have some influence on policy as part of a new deal.

breaking_news.headline: Customers report service outages at major US banks

breaking_news.headline: Create more jobs for under-25s by cutting National Insurance, key report urges
breaking_news.summary: Some parents are so desperate for their children to find a job that they've offered to pay their wages, one hairdresser has told the BBC.
